q: How long did the 30 cm parachute take to fall?
How much longer did the 50 cm parachute take than the 10 cm one?
Describe the relationship between canopy width and falling time.
A wider canopy takes longer to fall; the increase gets slightly smaller for bigger canopies.
Explain the results using forces, and state two control variables.
A bigger canopy has more area, so air resistance balances the weight at a lower speed. Controls: same load, same drop height, same string length, same material.
